_note: Methods page. Published in full on the frameworks library. No prices, no service ladders. 'url' empty = in development (shown without a link).

methods.name: LEVER
methods.line: Align the goal. Expose the friction. Sequence the fix.
methods.text: Decision diagnostics for organisations that have adopted AI and cannot show what it changed. LEVER maps every recurring decision, prices the friction in each, and sequences the one change that recovers it without breaking something downstream.

methods.name: RECALL
methods.line: Ask first. Score the corpus. Earn the right to build.
methods.text: A retrieval system cannot be better than the documents it retrieves from. RECALL measures a company's corpus against the questions people actually ask before anything is built, and can recommend against building.

methods.name: STAKE
methods.unit: The unit is a revenue stream
methods.line: Build it. Run it. Let the partner sell it.
methods.text: A product-partnership model for businesses that own a vertical and need a product they cannot build themselves, with a revenue ledger per deal.

methods.name: FLYWHEEL
methods.line: Score the business on eight dimensions. Find the drag.
methods.text: A venture diagnostic used with founders and students: eight dimensions, scored from evidence, to find which one is slowing everything else.

methods.name: Vibecoding
methods.unit: The unit is a shipped product
methods.line: From a worthy problem to a live URL.
methods.text: The twenty-step protocol taught at IED Madrid, LCC and in company training: how people who are not engineers ship working software with AI coding agents, under specification and review gates.

methods.name: Design Poiesis
methods.line: Every insight carries its trail from grounds to claim.
methods.text: A method for designers working with AI: five moves between two rails, so that each finding can be traced back to the evidence it came from. Working name.

tools.name: Five strategy canvases
tools.text: Category Design, Empathy, User Story Matrix, UX Strategy and AI Agent Design. Free A3 PDFs with quick guides.

case.name: Worked example: Language Kids World, Houston
case.text: A 60-person language-education organisation: the operation mapped first, then AI automations designed and sequenced so each relieved the next. Curriculum development went from weeks to hours, and the tools became a product partnership.
